**What broke** The dash had been switched to a flat “Clear” UI. No first-run workspace layout **What you get now** | Piece | Behavior | |--------|----------| | **Default layout** | Home ~left 62% full height; Chat top-right; Sessions bottom-right (closed until you open it).
